evidence.detail: The class extends R80 SequenceDefinitionConfigLoader, so its decoded value type and YAML semantics are fixed independently of its scanner-specific role.
Its only public load method resolves configs/anims.yaml relative to OsrsMapDependencyScanner's configured source root and parses that YAML through the scanner's YAML loader.
The method clears the inherited typed sequence-definition map, iterates every YAML ID, decodes each entry with the inherited sequence-definition decoder, and repopulates only absent IDs.

The instance is an inner scanner helper captured by OsrsMapDependencyScanner and is used specifically for the scanner's statement that it consumes client animation overrides and configs/*.yaml rather than serialized production configs.

proposals.note: OsrsSequenceOverrideLoader is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for the scanner-specific sequence override adapter. No surviving original source noun was found; confidence is 0.997.

evidence.detail: The class extends R80 ObjectDefinitionConfigLoader, fixing the underlying object-definition YAML decoder and typed override-map responsibility.
Its public load method resolves configs/objects.yaml relative to OsrsMapDependencyScanner's source root and rebuilds the inherited object-definition override map from scanner YAML data.
Entries are included only when explicitly marked osrs or when revision-forcing metadata is present; ordinary non-OSRS entries are skipped.

For each accepted entry the loader selects the OSRS versus ordinary ObjectDefinition mode and the corresponding paired definition byte arrays supplied by the scanner, then decodes the exact object override.

The loader rejects override IDs outside the active ObjectDefinition table with the exact diagnostic family 'Object override outside definition table', preventing silent scanner-only definition expansion.

proposals.note: OsrsObjectOverrideLoader is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for the scanner-specific OSRS object override adapter. No surviving original source noun was found; confidence is 0.997.
